cues: Relative motion does not always mean a shift.
If the source and observer move with the same velocity in the same direction, their separation stays constant, and f dash equals f.
At the instant a train passes you broadside, moving at right angles to the line joining you, there is no shift either.
And a steady wind changes nothing for a source and observer at rest, because it changes the speed of sound and the wavelength in exactly the same proportion.
